title: cotton linen tablecloth
text: cotton linen tablecloth. I purchased the "beige"... the flowers have red centers... for some reason I thought they would be white... but from a distance it's not real bright... Other than that, I really like this table cloth. I purchased to drape over a folding table really as a sort of dust cover.  Works nicely for that.
